items.raw_excerpt: A new national count will test whether Iceland’s harbour seals are recovering after a roughly 70% decline since 1980.
items.summary_en: A new national count will check whether Iceland's harbour seals are recovering. Their numbers have fallen by about 70 percent since 1980. The count will show whether conservation efforts are working.
items.summary_ko: 새 전국 조사는 아이슬란드의 물범 개체 수가 회복되고 있는지 확인합니다. 물범 수는 1980년 이후 약 70퍼센트 줄었습니다. 이번 조사로 보호 노력이 효과가 있는지 알 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Harbour seals remain endangered as Iceland starts a new national count
items.title_ko: 아이슬란드 물범 여전히 멸종 위기, 전국 조사 시작
items.title_original: Harbour Seals Remain Endangered as Iceland Begins New National Count

items.raw_excerpt: Kabe village residents brace for further delays in the resumption of the park-home clinic project
items.summary_en: People in Kabe Village near Mahikeng are still waiting for a promised clinic. The park-home clinic project is delayed again because the chosen land had sandy soil. Residents say they have waited more than 30 years for local healthcare.
items.summary_ko: 마히켕 인근 케이브 마을 주민들은 약속된 진료소를 아직도 기다리고 있습니다. 진료소 건립 공사가 땅이 모래땅이라는 문제로 또 다시 미뤄졌습니다. 주민들은 30년 넘게 가까운 의료 시설이 없다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Kabe Village residents face longer waits for a clinic
items.title_ko: 케이브 마을 주민들, 진료소 오픈 또 지연
items.title_original: Kabe Village residents brace for longer healthcare delays

items.raw_excerpt: The Colosseum has extended opening hours at night this summer to allow more visitors to see the famous Roman amphitheatre in cooler temperatures after sunset.
items.summary_en: The Colosseum in Rome has longer opening hours at night this summer. More visitors can see the old Roman amphitheater in cooler air after sunset.
items.summary_ko: 로마의 콜로세움이 이번 여름 야간 개장 시간을 늘렸습니다. 해가 진 뒤 시원해진 밤에, 오래된 로마 원형 극장을 더 많은 방문객이 둘러볼 수 있게 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Rome's Colosseum opens late at night this summer

items.title_original: Rome's Colosseum extends opening hours amid summer heatwaves

items.raw_excerpt: Although the wolf which has been causing quite a disturbance in West Jutland has been shot, wolves have been a concern to many people in Denmark, with some areas handing out pamphlets to tourists on what to do if they encounter a wolf.
items.summary_en: A wolf that caused trouble in West Jutland has been shot. But wolves still worry many people in Denmark. Some areas give tourists pamphlets about what to do if they meet a wolf.
items.summary_ko: 서부 유틀란트에서 말썽을 부리던 늑대가 사살됐지만, 덴마크에서는 여전히 늑대를 걱정하는 사람이 많다. 일부 지역에서는 늑대를 만났을 때 대처법을 담은 안내문을 관광객에게 나눠주고 있다.
items.title_en: What to do if you meet a wolf in Denmark
items.title_ko: 덴마크에서 늑대를 만나면 어떻게 해야 할까
items.title_original: What to do if you encounter a wolf in Denmark

items.raw_excerpt: Oslo is known as one of the best places in Norway for job opportunities, which attracts many international residents. Still, new statistics show that in several districts, many are not working or studying.
items.summary_en: Oslo is known as one of the best places in Norway for jobs, so many international residents move there. But new statistics show that in several districts, many people are not working or studying.
items.summary_ko: 오슬로는 노르웨이에서 일자리 기회가 가장 좋은 곳 중 하나로 알려져 있습니다. 덕분에 많은 외국인 주민이 모여들고 있습니다. 하지만 새 통계에 따르면 여러 지역구에서는 일하거나 공부하지 않는 사람이 많습니다.
items.title_en: Revealed: the Oslo districts with the most people out of work
items.title_ko: 일하지 않는 사람이 가장 많은 오슬로 지역구 공개
items.title_original: REVEALED: The Oslo districts with the most people out of the workforce

items.raw_excerpt: The last two or three weeks of the school summer holidays are challenging for parents in Sweden, who are expected to be back working long before their children are back at school. We'd like to hear from readers about how they manage.
items.summary_en: The last weeks of the summer school holiday are hard for parents in Sweden. Adults are back at work while children are still off school. The Local asks readers how they manage those weeks.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴에서 여름 방학 마지막 2~3주는 부모에게 힘든 시기입니다. 어른들은 이미 일터에 복귀했지만 아이들은 아직 학교에 가지 않기 때문입니다. The Local은 독자들이 어떻게 버티는지 이야기를 나눠 달라고 부탁합니다.
items.title_en: Tell us: How do Swedish parents survive the last summer weeks before school?
items.title_ko: 말해 주세요: 학교 개학 전 여름 마지막 주, 스웨덴 부모들은 어떻게 버티나요?
items.title_original: TELL US: How are you surviving the summer weeks before kids start school?

items.raw_excerpt: The word we're all waiting for by the middle of August.
items.summary_en: 'Tregua' means a pause or a rest. In the middle of August, Italians are waiting for a break from the hot summer. It can mean a truce or a short rest from daily life.
items.summary_ko: '트레구아'는 잠깐 멈추거나 쉰다는 뜻입니다. 8월 중순이 되면 이탈리아 사람들은 무더위를 피해 쉴 시간을 기다립니다. 이 단어는 휴전이라는 뜻과 일상의 짧은 휴식이라는 뜻을 모두 갖고 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Finding a good selection of books in English can be challenging for bibliophiles living outside the anglophone world. We’ve compiled a list of places to explore to satisfy your book-reading needs.
items.summary_en: Finding English books in Copenhagen can be hard for people who love reading. This guide lists the best places to buy them. Book lovers can use it to find their next read.

items.raw_excerpt: It might feel like most people in Austria are still on their summer holidays, but August 15th is also a nationwide public holiday. In 2026 it falls on a Saturday - here's why the date matters.
items.summary_en: Austria celebrates August 15th as a nationwide public holiday. In 2026, this day falls on a Saturday. Many people in Austria are still on their summer holidays.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아에서는 8월 15일이 전국 공휴일입니다. 2026년에는 이날이 토요일에 걸립니다. 많은 사람들이 아직 여름 휴가 중입니다.
items.title_en: Why August 15th is a public holiday in Austria
items.title_original: Why August 15th is a public holiday in Austria

items.raw_excerpt: Em dois dias, a Praia de Copacabana receberá, no Posto 2, quatro concertos gratuitos, entre eles dos cantores Samuel Rosa, nesta sexta-feira (14), e Alceu Valença, no sábado (15).
items.summary_en: In two days, Copacabana Beach will host four free concerts at Posto 2. Singers Samuel Rosa plays Friday and Alceu Valenca plays Saturday.
items.summary_ko: 이틀 안에 코파카바나 해변 포스토 2에서 무료 콘서트 네 번이 열립니다. 가수 사무엘 로사는 금요일에, 알세우 발렌사는 토요일에 공연합니다.
items.title_en: Free concerts come to Copacabana Beach
items.title_original: Concertos da Orquestra Ouro Preto terão Alceu Valença e Samuel Rosa

items.raw_excerpt: Spain's population density is a European anomaly, with 90 percent of residents living in just 2.6 percent of the country. Why is it that the cities are so crowded while huge parts of the country's interior are empty?
items.summary_en: In Spain, 90 percent of people live in just 2.6 percent of the country. The big cities are very crowded, but most of the interior is almost empty. It is a strange pattern for a European country.
items.summary_ko: 스페인에서는 국민 90퍼센트가 나라 면적의 2.6퍼센트에만 살고 있습니다. 큰 도시는 매우 붐비지만 내륙 대부분은 거의 텅 비어 있습니다. 유럽 국가로서는 아주 특이한 모습입니다.
items.title_en: Why do most people in Spain crowd into cities?
items.title_ko: 스페인 사람들은 왜 도시에만 몰려 살까?
items.title_original: Why is Spain's population so poorly distributed?

items.raw_excerpt: A cheeky little Danish word of the day for you to learn.
items.summary_en: Today's Danish word is fræk, which means cheeky or naughty. Danes use it to describe someone playful and a little daring. It is a fun word for everyday talk.
items.summary_ko: 오늘의 덴마크어 단어는 'fræk'입니다. 장난기 많고 조금 대담한 사람을 가리킬 때 쓰는 말입니다. 일상에서 자주 쓰는 재미있는 표현입니다.
items.title_en: Danish word of the day: fræk
items.title_original: Danish word of the day: fræk
